snippet.title: Mega Man Vs. Metroid
snippet.description:
Another flash game featuring Mega Man. This time, Mega Man explores the planet Zebes. But instead of defeating Kraid, Ridley, and Mother Brain, he battles against Samus.

Originally uploaded: February 17, 2009
